caption_L1: Here a bar diagram is called Climate change levy tax receipts in the United Kingdom from 2001/02 to 2019/20 (in million GBP). There is a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 2,000 on the x-axis, labeled Tax receipts in million GBP. There is a categorical scale starting at 2001/02 and ending at 2019/20 along the y-axis, marked Year.
caption_L2L3: Tax receipts were fairly stable from 2001/02 to 2012/13. They started to increase steadily in 2013/14 and have tripled since 2012/2013. Tax receipts growth has slowed in the last few years.
